known_findings_context.disposition: Established by predecessor, fixed in candidate; added cancellation test-source cases are consistent with the correction; no test executed.

observations.title: Synthetic private persistence and worker composition
observations.detail: Scan.privateCheckpoint and scanner test sources exercise gated in-memory CAS, InlineWorker and fake RPC. They express atomicity, stale-context cancellation, same-key replacement, history replay and conflict expectations, but this static review does not establish browser IndexedDB scheduling, real Worker transfer/termination or multitab runtime behavior. Imported helpers are not automatically credited by this report.

observations.title: Indexer header integrity does not establish record completeness
observations.detail: The reviewed test deliberately removes an announcement while retaining valid headers and expects successful return of the remaining single announcement. It separately rejects a missing header. This supports the predecessor completeness limitation; it is not a new defect or proof that a malicious source can be made complete.

observations.title: Bounded network tests are specified, not run
observations.detail: The test sources assert revocation, endpoint confinement, body caps, deadlines, fixed local errors and no redirected requests. networkAuthorization.adapters and transportNative define native loopback HTTP integration checks; boundedRequest.browser runs under jsdom. No test or server was executed, and these files do not by themselves prove actual browser or deployed-provider behavior.

observations.title: Performance fixture cannot establish device or network throughput
observations.detail: The performance source defines one deterministic 272-announcement fixture with in-memory RPC/CAS and InlineWorker; preparatory work warms the process, and no wall-clock ratio is an acceptance gate. Its measurements exclude browser IndexedDB, worker transfer/rendering, real networking and mobile throughput. No measurements were executed in this review.

rejected_hypotheses.title: UI CAS gate could intercept only initial reservation
rejected_hypotheses.conclusion: Rejected after source trace. Scan initialization opens and loads/reserves the private vault before Start becomes enabled; test open() waits for enabled Start before gates are installed. Therefore the gate can reach the later encrypted commit as intended.

constraints: Static source review only; no target code, builds, tests, proofs of concept, probes, network calls, transactions, application/test/config/dependency changes, git mutations or pushes.
